description: Definitions shared by Hiker Atlas's records (https://www.hikeratlas.com). In beta: may change.

routeKey.description: A route's key (recipe v1: https://github.com/hikeratlas/route-keys): a decodable cell part and a hash of the route's line, e.g. 1E57E06gbDEBBBICDGF.tn3dBnAuR_Q. Used as a fave's record key, and to tie tracks and reviews to a route.

alt.description: For people who can't see the photo.

at.description: Where it was taken, e.g. from its EXIF or its time on a track.
